scope: independent protected source review; no Farm execution

findings.summary: Pre-child census requires future-generated child/D73/output boundaries
findings.required: The PRE-child census may require preexisting source/schema/seed/interpreter/Node/route/admission inputs, but must not require child registration, child Python, or a new D73 manifest before their producing stages.
findings.observed: The single pre-child binding loop requires CHILD_BOOTSTRAP, P4_D73_MANIFEST, P4_D73_EVIDENCE, output roots, counters, poison manifest, and other post-request artifacts before the normal child request can begin.
findings.disposition: Do not proceed to child or body; author correction required before qualification.

findings.summary: The core command does not wire the required durable evidence roots
findings.required: The one unfiltered 22-root run must retain XML, raw runner, start/stop/disk evidence, and KEEP before cleanup.
findings.observed: The command passes only P4_D73_EVIDENCE to the existing launcher. JUNIT_ROOT, RAW_ROOT, STARTSTOP_ROOT, DISK_ADMISSION, RETAINED_ROOT, and KEEP_ROOT are checked by the census but are not passed to the launcher, pytest, CORE_ROUTE, or a retention wrapper. The text asserts preservation without an executable binding.
findings.disposition: No core result can be accepted from this packet until durable paths are part of the actual command route.

findings.summary: The claimed exact C0 wire summary is not the C0 schema
findings.required: The handoff must describe the actual v2 request/reply names from Runtime f103/C0.
findings.observed: The handoff calls step reads `optionalreads` and describes accepted replies as `canonical`, `base`, `landing`, `bindings`, `effects`, `dependencies`, `history`, and `undo_steps`. Runtime f103 contract/schemas/timeline-commit.json uses step `reads`, accepted `canonical_document`, base/previous/accepted IDs and `rebased_onto`; receipt is the outer envelope. Records/dependencies are nested/conditional, and history is a separate history shape. Conflict uses details `current` (not `head`).
findings.disposition: Correct the documentation against C0 before calling the recipe exact.

findings.summary: Import-check failure is not an explicit stop gate
findings.required: The registered-child checker must preserve mandatory/diagnostic classification and must not have its nonzero exit ignored before controls/core.
findings.observed: The command invokes IMPORT_CHECK_ROUTE but does not assert its exit status, inspect the emitted status, or stop before the next numbered block. The reviewed checker returns 1 for any failure, including mandatory and diagnostic failures.
findings.disposition: The receiving sequence needs an explicit status/classification gate before D73 controls.

findings.summary: Current Farm receipt bindings are existence-only
findings.required: Final tuple publication requires actual authenticated receipts, not arbitrary files or a mutable silent pin.
findings.observed: check_readonly_receipt marks any physical regular file as PASS and does not authenticate its schema, tuple, source/tree, producer, or digest. The current source/runtime checkout mismatches demonstrate why path existence cannot establish tuple custody.
findings.disposition: Require receipt-content authentication at the normal receiving route; retain source hashes as supporting evidence only.

findings.summary: Poison-manifest zeroing is documented but not audited before execution
findings.required: The poison manifest must be authenticated as the positive manifest with only agent_sha changed to forty zeroes.
findings.observed: The census checks only that POISON_MANIFEST is a physical file; it does not parse agent_sha, compare all other keys, or verify the positive-manifest digest. A nonzero/zero-counter result alone would not prove the intended poison control.
findings.disposition: Add a finite pre-run content comparison/zero-agent_sha guard; do not hand-edit or silently recapture manifests.

findings.summary: Schema closure files are not bound to the installed distribution
findings.required: The exact 18-row RECORD/direct_url/trusted-manifest closure must be the authenticated installed distribution input.
findings.observed: The receiver validates fixed hashes/content, but accepts SCHEMA_RECORD_CLOSURE and SCHEMA_DIRECT_URL as unrelated physical paths; it does not require them to be the dist-info RECORD and direct_url files under SCHEMA_INSTALLED_DISTRIBUTION, nor authenticate the manifest as a fixed digest.
findings.disposition: Bind and re-read the complete D139a closure through the maker/normal route; no arbitrary copied files or site-packages overlay.

custody_limit: Author evidence was recovered from the committed tree and permanent worker directory; author-relative paths are not treated as absolute execution receipts.
